statement.zh: **领域**：破译方法（Cryptanalysis）。RFC 4949 给出工作定义：cryptanalysis 是 「The mathematical science that deals with analysis of a       cryptographic system to gain knowledge needed to break or       circumvent the protection that the system is designed to provide.」（研究分析密码系统以获取突破或绕过其防护所需知识的数学科学）。其教学注记先记录较早、较窄的目标——「Definition 2 states the traditional goal of       cryptanalysis, i.e., convert cipher text to plain text (which       usually is clear text) without knowing the key; but that       definition applies only to encryption systems.

FIPS 203 表明密码分析是标准化的输入，而不是外来事件。新标准随附的强度数字本身就是对他人攻击的分析结果：「Each of the parameter sets of ML-KEM comes with an associated security strength that was estimated based on current cryptanalysis (see Section 8 for details).」（ML-KEM 的每个参数组都配有依据当前密码分析估计的安全强度（详见第 8 节））。被分析的假设点名为：「The security of ML-KEM is based on the presumed hardness of the so-called Module Learning with Errors (MLWE) problem [9], which is a generalization of the Learning With Errors (LWE) problem introduced by Regev in 2005 [10].」（ML-KEM 的安全性基于 Module-LWE 问题的假定困难性；它是 Regev 于 2005 年提出的 LWE 问题的推广）。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in cryptanalysis, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 词汇表把这套分类变成了具名技术，该条目目其余部分就是用这些名字思考的。唯密文攻击：「A cryptanalysis technique in which the analyst tries to       determine the key solely from knowledge of intercepted cipher text」（分析者仅凭截获的密文试图确定密钥的密码分析技术）——更完整的词条还说明分析者可能知道算法、语言与可能的明文词。选择明文攻击：「A cryptanalysis technique in which the analyst tries to       determine the key from knowledge of cipher text that corresponds       to plain text selected (i.e., dictated) by the analyst.」（分析者利用由自己选定的明文所对应的密文来确定密钥的技术。）选择密文攻击把选择对象反过来：「A cryptanalysis technique in which the analyst tries to       determine the key from knowledge of plain text that corresponds to       cipher text selected (i.e., dictated) by the analyst.」（分析者利用对应到自己选定的密文的明文来确定密钥的技术。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: RFC 7465 是一份由密码分析走向禁令的记录。RC4 「However, RC4 has long    been known to have a variety of cryptographic weaknesses, e.g., see    [PAU], [MAN], and [FLU].」（然而 RC4 早已被发现存在多种密码学弱点，见 [PAU]、[MAN] 与 [FLU]。）——它被广泛支持且常被 TLS 服务器偏好；随后 「Recent cryptanalysis results [ALF] exploit    biases in the RC4 keystream to recover repeatedly encrypted    plaintexts.」（近期的密码分析结果利用 RC4 密钥流的偏置，恢复被反复加密的明文。）攻击的代价印在同一段：「These recent results are on the verge of becoming practically    exploitable; currently, they require 2^26 sessions or 13x2^30    encryptions.」（这些结果即将具备实际可利用性：目前需要 2^26 个会话或 13x2^30 次加密。）——这里的插入符指数记号在抽取中存活，照印刷形式引用。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: RFC 8017（第 15 行署 2016 年 11 月）在自己的参考清单里印出了一份带年代的密码分析年表。Dobbertin 的攻击以 「Cryptanalysis of MD4」（MD4 的密码分析）为题，载 Lecture Notes in Computer Science 第 1039 卷、1996 年（rfc8017.txt:2771-2773，题名片段照该行印刷形式引用）；Wang、Yao 与 Yao 以 「Cryptanalysis on SHA-1」（SHA-1 的密码分析）为题，载第 2442 卷、2005 年 2 月（第 2896-2898 行）；Manger 2001 年论文的题目片段 「A Chosen Ciphertext Attack on RSA Optimal」（针对 RSA 最优……的选择密文攻击）印在第 2765 行——该题名的其余部分跨过一段大缩进换行，因此只引用这一片段。叙述性附录把文献串成时间线：「The cryptanalysis of MD4 has progressed    significantly in the intervening years.」（其间 MD4 的密码分析大幅推进），「There have also been advances in the cryptanalysis of SHA-1.」（SHA-1 的密码分析也有进展）。因此这份留存件能支撑的是一条具体年表：1996 至 2005 年间发表的、被 2016 年标准点名引用的攻击，以及该标准对 MD4/MD5 的降级和对 SHA-1 的回退兼容限定。
